page.overview:
Who is Bail Antilles?

Bail Antilles was a human galactic trader and a confederate of the Aquillian Ranger Clieg Whitsun. He was as a rugged-looking man wearing fur and golden ornaments.

The name "Bail Antilles" first appeared in May 1974, in the 132-page rough draft to the film that would become Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope. The revised fourth draft established the character of "Bail Antilles, Viceroy and Chairman of the Alderaan system" as the father of Princess Leia Organa from the planet Alderaan.

When Princess Leia's homeworld was renamed Alderaan, the name "Ogana" was slightly respelled and attributed to the royal family. Bail Antilles was accordingly renamed Bail Organa, and went on to be mentioned by name in the novelization of A New Hope, although he was only referred to simply as Princess Leia's father in the film itself. In Star Wars (1977) 2, the second issue of the film's comic book adaptation by Marvel Comics, Leia's father was erroneously referred to as "Bail Antillies [sic], Viceroy of Alderaan." Eventually, Bail Antilles was established as a separate character from Organa during the development of the Star Wars prequel trilogy, specifically as Organa's predecessor as the senator of Alderaan.
